name: Kuzushi
summary: Agentic SAST scanner with AI triage.
metaDescription: Kuzushi is an agentic SAST scanner for AppSec teams, with source-to-sink hunting, AI triage, traceable findings, and replayable scan artifacts.
description: Kuzushi is an agentic application-security scanner that maps code, hunts source-to-sink paths, triages findings, and keeps scan evidence replayable across shell, run, and scan workflows.
focus: ProdSec and AppSec automation for teams that need evidence-backed vulnerability review.
highlights: Modular scanner runtime for DAG-based security pipelines.
Agentic triage surfaces that reduce false-positive review load.
Replayable artifacts, trace output, and Rust-native operator UI.

name: mcp-pentest
summary: MCP server for authorized pentest workflows.
metaDescription: mcp-pentest is an MCP server for authorized pentest workflows with Nmap, Gobuster, OSINT context, AI-assisted triage, and reporting.
description: mcp-pentest exposes authorized network and web-enumeration workflows through Model Context Protocol so operators can orchestrate Nmap, Gobuster, OSINT context, triage, and reporting from an agent host.
focus: Security automation for controlled, scoped penetration testing.
highlights: MCP-native interface for scoped pentest task execution.
Tooling around Nmap, Gobuster, OSINT context, and reports.
Built for authorized workflows instead of open-ended offensive automation.

name: SignalTrace
metaDescription: SignalTrace is a real-time OSINT dashboard for conflict, crisis, maritime, aviation, infrastructure, and humanitarian signals.
description: SignalTrace turns conflict, crisis, maritime, aviation, infrastructure, radiation, and humanitarian signals into a real-time OSINT dashboard for situational awareness.
focus: OSINT, NatSec, crisis monitoring, and geospatial intelligence workflows.
highlights: Map-first interface for fast signal review.
Conflict, infrastructure, maritime, aviation, and humanitarian streams.
Cloudflare Workers, React, Leaflet, and Hono architecture.

name: VolatilityAI
metaDescription: VolatilityAI is a Volatility3 memory-forensics companion for DFIR triage, timelines, report diffing, and grounded LLM-assisted investigation.
description: VolatilityAI is a DFIR companion for Volatility3 that combines deterministic memory-forensics rules, timelines, report diffing, and grounded LLM-assisted investigation.
focus: Memory forensics and incident response workflows.
highlights: Timelines, report diffing, and incident-response summaries.
LLM-assisted DFIR without replacing deterministic analysis.

name: zkdpop-go
summary: Zero-knowledge login and sender-constrained tokens in Go.
metaDescription: zkdpop-go is a Go framework for Schnorr ZK login, DPoP-bound JWTs, proof-of-possession auth, and ready-to-use middleware.
description: zkdpop-go is a Go framework for interactive Schnorr zero-knowledge authentication, short-lived JWTs, DPoP key binding, and ready-to-use middleware.
focus: Applied cryptography, authentication, and proof-of-possession access control.
highlights: JWT verification bound to client DPoP keys.
Reference auth server and middleware for Go services.

name: detonate
metaDescription: detonate is a malware-analysis sandbox with Docker, QEMU, telemetry, YARA, Suricata, threat-intel enrichment, and AI reports.
description: detonate is a malware-analysis sandbox with Docker and QEMU execution, telemetry, YARA, Suricata, threat-intelligence enrichment, and AI-assisted reports.
focus: Malware analysis, reverse engineering, and DFIR lab automation.
highlights: Sandbox execution paths around Docker and QEMU.
YARA, Suricata, telemetry, and threat-intel enrichment.
